critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: /app/backend/server.py:338 had a stray '@api_router.get("/seller/stats")' decorator with no function body. This decorator was silently attached to the next-defined function (create_product), registering GET /api/seller/stats -> create_product which requires a POST body -> 422 for every GET call. It also duplicated the real /seller/stats route defined at line 642. The stray decorator has been removed. Root cause suggests an incomplete refactor; recommend running `python -c 'import server'` in CI to catch such issues, and adding a startup route-uniqueness assertion.

rca of the issue: Bug: GET /api/seller/stats returned 422. Reproduction: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <seller-token>' /api/seller/stats` returns 422 with 'body Field required'. Root cause: /app/backend/server.py line 338 had a floating `@api_router.get("/seller/stats")` decorator (no function on the next non-blank line). Python decorator chaining meant it was applied to the subsequent `create_product` function together with `@api_router.post("/products")`, registering GET /seller/stats -> create_product which requires a POST body. FastAPI matched the first-registered route so all GET /seller/stats calls hit create_product -> 422. Impact: SellerDashboard.loadAll() uses Promise.all with /seller/stats first — one rejection broke the entire seller dashboard rendering (stats, products, orders, riders, earnings). Fix: removed the stray decorator. Mitigation: add a smoke test hitting every registered GET route on server startup.
